properties.name: valid_tier_membership
properties.description: Returns exactly one of the lowercase tier names: 'basic', 'plus', or 'pro'.

properties.name: basic_tier_interval
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: (result == 'basic') if (0 <= args[0] < 100) else (result != 'basic')
properties.description: Any amount in [0, 100) maps to 'basic', and amounts outside this range do not.

properties.name: plus_tier_interval
properties.predicate_src: lambda args, result: (result == 'plus') if (100 <= args[0] <= 1000) else (result != 'plus')
properties.description: Any amount in [100, 1000] maps to 'plus', and amounts outside this range do not.

properties.name: pro_tier_interval
properties.description: Any amount strictly greater than 1000 maps to 'pro', and amounts <= 1000 do not.
